name: context-vault
description: Persistent structured memory for Claude Code. HTTP hooks server (localhost:9742) writes all session events to SQLite JSONB. RingDumper measures accumulated context and signals Claude via UserPromptSubmit stdout injection. Three skills: prends-note (LLM writes entities on its own initiative), hot-contexte (targeted SQL query before compaction), project-mgmt (todos with dependencies). /note command for user-initiated entries. Schema is fully dynamic — types and attributes emerge from usage.
